contexts.text: Concerning revealed theology, or the Word, and concerning natural theology. General article. DeVerbo 6.

It was shown further that natural theology can manifest nothing whatever concerning the Divine, Heaven and Hell, the life after death, faith, unless they had previously known them from revelation... Explained. DeVerbo 6:3.
The dragon = ... those who want to be wise concerning Divine things from natural theology...
He had believed that natural theology illustrates minds...
No one can enter from natural theology into spiritual theology; but everyone can from spiritual theology enter into natural theology...
There is not any natural theology without revelation...
